div.div: قِبَةٌ The thing that is in the belly, resembling the فَحِث: (TA:) the إِنْفَحَّة [a name given to the stomach of a sucking kid, &c.] when it has grown large, of a شاة, [i. e., a sheep or goat or the like]: (K:) not in any animals but those termed شاء: (IAar:) mentioned before, in art. قب, [q. v., where it is also written قِبَّةٌ]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
